name: nexusflow
description: NexusFlow - Visual IoT Telemetry & Rule Engine

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.demo: concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run demo:memory -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w client
